answer: Trust moves at exactly the second a grantor's slashable bond locks on-chain, at block 18432, 09:14:07 UTC, when the grantee's vertex first gains weight in the reputation trellis. Each transfer publishes a one-time nullifier, a hash of bond ID plus block height, so replaying the same grant twice hits an already-spent nullifier and the chain rejects it. Agents therefore anchor identity in burned collateral, and no fresh sybil can enter this haven without paying a bond it cannot recycle.
